resources.string: Experimental build for SM-S948B on S948BXXS4AZHL. Choose a backend, then start Shizuku through wireless debugging before rooting. These builds still need testing on your phone. Changing an active backend requires a full reboot. Existing modules are disabled when changing backends; re-enable compatible modules in the chosen manager.
Open the app and choose a root backend before starting.
%1$s selected for the next root attempt.
%1$s selected. Reboot before starting the new backend.
Disable existing modules before loading. Re-enable compatible modules in the selected manager. Backend changes always disable existing modules.
AZHL always loads the selected backend during rooting.
